bibliographicPolicy.edition: Validated ISBN; ISBN-10 normalized to equivalent ISBN-13
bibliographicPolicy.work: Normalized explicit original title or listing title plus author; only recognizable edition/format suffix removed. Heuristic, not an authority database.
bibliographicPolicy.series: Explicit narrative series with compatible author; at most one per selection. Publisher collection is not a saga.
bibliographicPolicy.collection: Declared contents exclude included work; missing contents are treated conservatively.
bibliographicPolicy.unknown: Unknown authors, alternative translated titles without explicit original title and absent series metadata are not certified. Two unresolved book identities cannot fill separate slots.
bibliographicPolicy.refinement: Work/series/edition keys travel in enumerated rejectedBookKeys; source notes remain local
bibliographicPolicy.paper: Paper binding/title must be explicit; digital, absent and contradictory formats fail a paper-only request
bibliographicPolicy.standalone: Explicit standalone statement required; absence of series is not proof
